keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Match any keyword in the title or description, e.g. cybersecurity, janitorial, drone.

naicsCodes.title: NAICS codes
naicsCodes.description: NAICS codes or prefixes, e.g. 541512 (computer systems design) or 5415.

setAsideCodes.title: Set-aside codes
setAsideCodes.description: e.g. SBA (total small business), 8A, SDVOSBC, WOSB, HZC.

noticeTypes.title: Notice types
noticeTypes.description: e.g. Solicitation, Combined Synopsis/Solicitation, Presolicitation, Sources Sought, Award Notice.

agencies.title: Agencies
agencies.description: Match department, sub-tier or office names, e.g. defense, veterans affairs, NASA.

states.title: Place of performance states
states.description: Two-letter US state codes, e.g. VA, TX, CA.

postedAfter.title: Posted on or after
postedAfter.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to the last 3 days. Older dates scan more of the dataset.

sinceLastRun.title: Only new opportunities since last run
sinceLastRun.description: Incremental mode for daily alerts: returns only notices you have not received before for the same filters.

descriptionChars.title: Description length
descriptionChars.description: Truncate descriptions to this many characters (0 = omit).
